test_title: PYST 16: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) WQ-BI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9dc9938c70717a951e9f47ff064643894059a20c0f33b32cf5f9adc68076781a.png] 

Option 2) UO-ZG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5984d0b7ad21c2ee350a9db8cc29d02e2cb5100907478ca03015e83beb1f7a0a.png] 

Option 3) JD-OW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/964bc4e60d0d6daf55c1c56b83c592d0ae36cb8d368e2bc25cb25b8b9216ca82.png] 

Option 4) BV-GN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce10038d45c969cedde8d6fd777a6c41d9cf037eaccddacbc9529f9c6026d5cd.png] 

Thus, out of all "JD-OW" is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
